entities.rationale: Group-of-users icon at top right; data scientists accessing the portal via CloudFront.

entities.rationale: Box labeled SANOFI SSO at top left; external corporate identity provider federated with Cognito.

entities.name: S3 Static Website
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon in the center row (unlabeled); hosts the static website portal.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Icon labeled API GATEWAY; dynamic part of the portal.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Icon labeled DYNAMO DB; stores user metadata and traceability of actions.

entities.name: Service Catalog
entities.rationale: Icon labeled SERVICE CATALOG; portfolio of products (SageMaker, RStudio) provisioned via CloudFormation.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda icon; functions calling the Translate and Comprehend Medical SDKs.

entities.name: R Studio
entities.rationale: EC2-style icon labeled R STUDIO; RStudio product provisioned through Service Catalog.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: Icon labeled SAGEMAKER; encrypted per-user notebooks provisioned through Service Catalog.

entities.name: Translate
entities.rationale: Icon labeled TRANSLATE; bulk translation of raw files invoked by Lambda.

entities.name: Comprehend Medical
entities.rationale: Icon labeled COMPREHEND MEDICAL; entity identification in raw files and language detection, invoked by Lambda.

entities.name: Data Lake
entities.rationale: Bucket icon at the bottom labeled DATA LAKE (partly hidden by subtitles); sensitive data and per-user home buckets. No drawn lines to it are visible.
